title: Empirica observer: the store summary (GET /api/view, observe)
description: Every project, run and claim the observer can read, with the facts the view draws and filters. Produced only by the plugin's observer; the UI joins, counts and filters and derives nothing. Enumerations mirror their owners and are held equal by scripts/validate_ui_view.py: run state = public-contract statuses; audit = audit_states; claim kind = claim_kinds; claim state = claim_states; blocker = reasons. A null is unknown, never a default.

token.description: Digest of each project's id, name and repo and its ordered run keys and versions: equal tokens mean the same view (the server's ETag).

projects.description: Ordered by each project's most recently updated run, newest first.

id.description: The plugin's storage id (a one-way digest; never shown as a label).

name.description: Display name: the matched repository's folder name; null when no repository matched.

repo.description: The matched repository's top-level path on this machine; null when none matched.

previous.description: The same run's previous generation, when the store has it.

updated.description: When the run's state file last changed (file modification time, seconds since the epoch).

version.description: Changes whenever anything the row was projected from changes: the state and history revisions, whether the prior generation is present, the state file's modification time, and, for a run with active spikes, the observation of the files they depend on (a workspace edit alone can change it).

state.description: The plugin's run status; null when the state could not be read.

diagnostic.description: Why the observer could not read everything. older-format: the state does not have this plugin's shape (typically an earlier plugin version wrote it); only goal and status are read. unreadable: not decodable, or of the current shape but breaking the plugin's invariants (damage, not age); nothing is read. history-unavailable: no repository given maps to the run's project. history-missing: the repository given holds no history for this run. history-corrupt: the recorded history fails the plugin's checks. workspace-unavailable: the files its spikes depend on could not be observed (looked at again on every read). Null when fully read.

audit.description: The plugin's audit state (a pass counts only while bound to the current argument); null when the history was not read.

root.description: The root claim's id; null exactly when there are no claims.

gating.description: In the run's effective scope (its approval gates convergence).

blocker.description: The plugin's blocker reason code for a scoped claim that is not approved (a public-contract reason); null otherwise.

blocker_claim.description: The claim whose resolution the blocker waits on: this claim, or the supporting claim the plugin redirected it to (a claim blocked by an unresolved supporter carries that supporter's reason). Null exactly when blocker is null.

evidence.description: The strongest kind among the claim's active evidence: a spike, else research, else none.

review.description: The claim against the latest audit verdict: passed = reviewed with today's evidence by the current passing audit; failed = reviewed by a failing verdict; stale = reviewed with today's evidence by a pass that no longer binds the argument; changed = its evidence changed since it was reviewed; unreviewed = the verdict did not review it; none = no verdict yet.
